cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about your trousers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry I interrupted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about your trousers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry I interrupted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told the trainees their head trainer was an idiot. I want an apology.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry your drill failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For undermining their head trainer. They still need to follow my instructions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email them after tomorrow's drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read it to them before the drill. My whistle isn't going to outrank 'idiot' on its own.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints.

cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Please book before we lose the coach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.
